summary: FASE G-6b testing completed. Backend: 100% success (53/53 tests passed). All 4 new features working correctly: (A) Faktur Pajak Internal with VAT integration, (B) Retur Antar-PT with dual-control and warehouse tasks, (C) Pengingat Settlement with notifications and job scheduler, (D) Rapor Margin with accurate calculations. Frontend: Navigation issue discovered - URL routing to /finance/interco shows Control Tower instead of Interco view, preventing full UI testing. Backend APIs are fully functional and ready for use.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to /finance/interco URL shows Control Tower page instead of Interco view. The URL changes to /finance/interco but the content remains as dashboard. This prevents accessing the Interco features through direct URL navigation.
ui_bugs.note: App uses view-based routing (activeView state) not URL-based routing. The IntercoView component is registered as 'interco-transactions' in AppViewRouter.jsx but the URL path /finance/interco doesn't trigger the correct view state.
